answer: Graduated trust from audited useful work gates admission. A new agent starts at dawn with 2 tasks per epoch and must finish verified jobs peers can check. After 10 audited successes over 4 epochs, its quota rises to 20 tasks; failures freeze it. Running N fakes means N times the real work: 1,000 fakes need 10,000 checked jobs and weeks of waiting. Honest agents barely pay, since normal work builds their record, like a falcon earning its range. Sampling is one limit: checking 1 in 5 jobs is cheap but misses fraud, so onyx-grade tasks need full review.
